description: This file defines the interface for a composition buffer used in the WPEFramework project, including classes, enums, and methods related to buffer handling, planes, and rendering.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: Interface for a hardware-optimized frame buffer, providing methods for buffer management, accessor, rendering, and plane iteration.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a single plane in the buffer with methods to access data offset, stride, and a data accessor.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing planes within a composition buffer.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the buffer.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count, possibly freeing the object.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the buffer's planes, with an optional timeout parameter.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Indicates that the caller is done with the planes, possibly for hardware update or cleanup.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for rendering or scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns pixel arrangement details used for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (invalid, DMA, raw).
